opennyai_summary.decision:
The present petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking the following prayers:
"(a) Allow this Writ Petition and Issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the Respondent No. 2 to treat the Petitioner's notice dated 26.06.2025 and 08.10.2025 as a formal complaint under Rule 4(3)(e) of the FSS Rules, 2011 and to forthwith investigate the errant FBOs in Annexure P-6 by exercising powers under Sections 41-42 of the FSS Act, 2006, including inspection, seizure and sampling;
(b) Issue a consequential direction commanding the Respondent No. 2 to initiate immediate action under Section 32 of the Act against the errant FBOs by issuing Improvement Notices under sub-section (1) and upon failure to comply, to suspend and cancel their FSSAI licenses under sub-sections (2) and (3) of Section 32;
(c) Further direct Respondent No. 2 to initiate suspension and/or cancellation proceedings under Section 32(2)-(3) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 against the said errant FBOs for their continued non-compliance with the provisions of the Act and for committing misbranding within the meaning of Section 3(1)(zf)
